subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add registerControlUiEntryPoint as a separate public plugin UI API, or fold its launch-token behavior into the existing surface: "tab" descriptor seam with one sandboxed browser trust model?
rationale: This is a durable plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser security contract; automation can identify unsafe paths, but maintainers must choose the permanent API and isolation model before third-party plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with token launch behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed through one public seam.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep registerControlUiEntryPoint only after removing top-level execution, using an opaque iframe sandbox, failing closed on launch errors, and adding exact-head proof.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66944 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 settle native plugin page semantics and browser trust boundaries.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with token launch behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed through one public seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged generic plugin host-hook foundation and are the closest history signal for this public plugin UI API-shape decision.
